raw_r_definition: max rank assignments / mean rank assignments

A.rule: positive raw and padded max improvement; rank by padded then raw improvement

B.rule: raw max improvement within 10% of the selected A median and padded max improvement separated from A by at least one 128-row step; minimize padded improvement, then raw-distance

C.rule: bottom quartile of absolute raw-r change; maximize aligned-load vector change, then aligned-r change

D.rule: uniform sample without replacement from all remaining legal swaps
